sentences.en: Three old women are sitting at a table, striping goosefeathers.
sentences.zh: 三名老妇人正坐在桌旁，给鹅毛染色。

sentences.en: I would like to try the blue striped skirt.
sentences.zh: 我想试试那条蓝色条纹的裙子。

sentences.en: Decorated with blue and yellow stripes, the tie was very unfashionable.
sentences.zh: 这条蓝黄相间的领带看起来很不时髦。
